test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Number of books issued by a library for 6 months has been represented in the following bar graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8be301051e4ce3a296bb3057d9af67086df617e6fe7fe7a1271828d96ef07a4f.png] 

In which month the maximum number of books were issued?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Number of books issued by a library for 6 months 

**CALCULATION:**

January has number of books = 5000 

April has number of books = 5500 

May has number of books = 7500 

Feb has number of books = 6000

**Hence, May has maximum number of books issued .**
